name: glcheck
what: no draw call raises a GL error (BASE_URL=; GL_JS= runs a snippet in the page first); exits 1 on any, or on a page error

name: fovtest-phone
what: the field of view slider at 35, 50, 75 and 110: the label says what the number is, Settings fits at 390 px, tapping a building selects it, edge scrolling (desk), draw calls per angle; pictures in shots/r8/fov

name: fovtest-desk
what: the same on the desktop (1280x720): the mouse at the screen edge still scrolls the map at every angle

name: suite
what: runs every test in this list against BASE_URL, two at a time, a timeout each; results go to a summary file as they finish, so a rerun resumes (--retry-failed, --only a,b, --list, --lint); prints a table

name: gesturetest
what: phone: pinching or panning with two fingers keeps a planned road or service (real touch events); a stroke that turns into a pinch plans nothing

name: soak
what: a simulated year: errors, NaN, save/continue, leaks

name: qualitytest
what: graphics presets never change the simulation

name: nantest
what: one NaN/Inf pixel can't black out the screen; black-frame fallback

name: scaletest
what: people, cars and boats in proportion to the town; one person out of a door at a time

name: shadercheck
what: no sin-based hashes in shaders (they break on some Windows GPUs)

name: motiontest
what: cars: no heading snaps, brake for turns, change lanes, blink, never wrong-way on a one-way; walkers' stride, no teleports

name: snapshot
what: (tooling) serves a frozen copy of the tree with its own Vite cache, so editing src/ never reloads a running capture; scripts/withslot.sh <command> runs it in one of two shared browser slots (at most two headless Chromium jobs at once); scripts/worktree.sh <name> makes a scratch worktree for a parallel helper

name: starttest
what: new county: sensible site (random among good ones, saved), county road follows the land; trees: no detail disc, no gaps; far trees keep their shape (no rectangles)

name: leakprobe
what: heap after forced GC across a 420-day run of a stable town, with building, car and DOM counts, to spot leaks
note: prints numbers only, no threshold; long

name: loopcheck
what: counts live render-loop frames over N seconds, optionally after setup JS

name: perfTown
what: builds a repeatable 7x7 town, runs 270 days and records the F3 performance numbers and screenshots to shots/perf

name: refblock
what: library: opens the reference block (the fixture town) for the look and traffic scripts: openBlock, shoot, seeds

name: servicesviews
what: screenshots of service buildings, problem icons, info views, the services panel and the inspector

name: shot
what: generic helper: screenshots any URL after optional JS and prints the last console lines

name: views
what: multi-view screenshots in one session, each view set up by its own JS, with frame ms and headless fps
note: ignores BASE_URL (port 5173); takes no shots without VIEWS

name: gate
what: the gate (npm run gate): typecheck, the build and its size budget, the tests that need no browser, the registry lint
